definitions.render_rule: Emit four headings in order: name, purpose, role, hard rules; values are NFC-normalized blueprint strings and hard rules are lexicographically sorted bullet lines.
Emit the canonical JSON projection of schema_version, candidate_id, identity, objectives, capabilities, boundaries, requirements, and authority in that key set only.
Emit canonical JSON containing fixture_id, candidate_id, one synthetic user input, and the expected provider_free boolean; no clock, random, environment, or host value is permitted.
Emit a Python 3.11 unittest module implementing ASSERT-001 through ASSERT-006 in numeric order using only hashlib, json, pathlib, tempfile, unicodedata, and unittest.

Emit canonical JSON containing contract_id, canonical ordered file records with media type and SHA-256, root_digest, normalization_contract_id, template_set_id, and false authority flags; exclude its own bytes from root_digest and record its post-serialization hash separately.
